thread.title: Analysts Set Expectations for Apple’s Q3 2018 Earnings (AAPL)

author: Ethan Ryder
title: Analysts Set Expectations for Apple’s Q3 2018 Earnings (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Research analysts at Oppenheimer cut their Q3 2018 earnings per share (EPS) estimates for shares of Apple in a research note issued on Sunday, April 29th. Oppenheimer analyst A. Uerkwitz now forecasts that the iPhone maker will earn $1.98 per share for the quarter, down from their prior forecast of $2.12. Oppenheimer currently has a “Hold” rating on the stock. Oppenheimer also issued estimates for Apple’s Q4 2018 earnings at $2.43 EPS, FY2018 earnings at $11.01 EPS, FY2019 earnings at $11.76 EPS and FY2020 earnings at $13.04 EPS. Get Apple alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The company had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. During the same quarter last year, the firm earned $2.10 earnings per share. The company’s revenue was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. AAPL has been the subject of a number of other research reports. Macquarie set a $188.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Friday, January 26th. Barclays dropped their target price on Apple from $170.00 to $168.00 and set an “equal weight” rating for the company in a report on Friday, March 16th. Zacks Investment Research raised Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 target price for the company in a report on Thursday, January 18th. Piper Jaffray reissued a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, January 2nd. Finally, Bank of America cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and raised their price target for the stock from $180.00 to $220.00 in a research report on Wednesday, January 17th. Two equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $203.11.
AAPL opened at $169.10 on Wednesday. Apple has a fifty-two week low of $142.20 and a fifty-two week high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a current ratio of 1.24 and a quick ratio of 1.20. The firm has a market cap of $838,531.38, a PE ratio of 18.36, a PEG ratio of 1.26 and a beta of 1.26.
The company also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, May 17th. Stockholders of record on Monday, May 14th will be given a dividend of $0.73 per share. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.73%. This is a boost from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 27.36%.
In related news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201 in the last ninety days. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
A number of institutional investors and hedge funds have recently modified their holdings of the stock. Vantage Financial Partners Ltd. Inc. bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at about $400,000. University of Texas Investment Managment Co. bought a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter valued at about $114,000. FNY Managed Accounts LLC increased its position in shares of Apple by 852.4% during the 2nd quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after purchasing an additional 716 shares during the last quarter. Santori & Peters Inc. bought a new position in Apple during the 4th quarter worth approximately $149,000. Finally, Oak Point Wealth Management bought a new position in Apple during the 4th quarter worth approximately $163,000. 61.18% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
